decisions.reason: Although uptake was likely hurt by the pandemic shock to air travel, management can plausibly treat this as temporary and, having already invested in a publicly promoted airport digitalization product, is inclined to continue.

This product had the strongest visible public launch commitment, so under escalation of commitment management is especially likely to justify the investment and keep it on the market while aviation demand recovers.

As a self-service check-in offering closely related to the firm’s airport-security positioning, it fits the announced direction and disappointing early results can still be blamed on temporary market conditions rather than product failure.
